column1: # Partition table for the PhotoPainter's 16 MB flash. Two OTA slots
# factory app. 6 MB per slot leaves the image (~1.5 MB) room to grow without ever needing
# a cable to change this table -- OTA cannot rewrite it. NVS is 64 KB because it also
# holds the cached week of events (up to ~11 KB) shown when a fetch fails.
